entries.title: Psalms 5:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician upon Nehiloth, A Psalm of David.>> Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.

entries.title: Psalms 5:2
segments: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.

words.text: : for unto thee will I pray

entries.title: Psalms 5:3
segments: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct [my prayer] unto thee, and will look up.

words.text: [my prayer] unto thee, and will look up

entries.title: Psalms 5:4
segments: For thou [art] not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

entries.title: Psalms 5:5
segments: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity. {in...: Heb. before thine eyes}

entries.title: Psalms 5:6
segments: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man. {bloody...: Heb. man of bloods and deceit}

words.text: . {bloody...: Heb. man of bloods and deceit}

entries.title: Psalms 5:7
segments: ¶But as for me, I will come [into] thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: [and] in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple. {thy holy...: Heb. the temple of thy holiness}

words.text: ¶But as for me, I will come
. {thy holy...: Heb. the temple of thy holiness}

entries.title: Psalms 5:8
segments: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face. {mine...: Heb. those which observe me}

entries.title: Psalms 5:9
segments: For [there is] no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part [is] very wickedness; their throat [is] an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue. {faithfulness: or, stedfastness} {their mouth: Heb. his mouth, that is, the mouth of any of them} {very...: Heb. wickednesses}

words.text: . {faithfulness: or, stedfastness} {their mouth: Heb. his mouth, that is, the mouth of any of them} {very...: Heb. wickednesses}

entries.title: Psalms 5:10
segments: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee. {Destroy...: or, Make them guilty} {by...: or, from their counsels}

words.text: against thee. {Destroy...: or, Make them guilty} {by...: or, from their counsels}

entries.title: Psalms 5:11
segments: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee. {defendest...: Heb. coverest over, or, protectest them}

entries.title: Psalms 5:12
segments: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as [with] a shield. {compass: Heb. crown}
